items.title: Frank Strazzeri interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: I did a couple of tours with him

ctx.x: Yeah. You’re not sure sometimes if people are making jokes or if they’re serious about things.
I didn’t understand them, and neither I think did he understand me. Although I ended up working with Elvis Presley. I worked with Elvis, I did a couple of tours with him, and it’s on that paper.
